lessons.key: gate_fail::codeql pr check treats a flagged pattern on any diff touched line as a new alert even when the pattern is unchanged and only moved security fixes that refactor flagged regex code must expect the gate to re fire on the branch and must eliminate the pattern class not just the originally flagged instance
lessons.text: CodeQL PR check treats a flagged pattern on any diff-touched line as a NEW alert, even when the pattern is unchanged and only moved. Security fixes that refactor flagged regex code must expect the gate to re-fire on the branch and must eliminate the pattern class, not just the originally flagged instance.

lessons.key: gate_fail::a registry count change 15 17 specialists shipped green under test scripts but ci went red the four plugin install test rosters shell installer advisories config cli help readme features marketplace copy are covered by test plugins which the local spec driven final gate did not run when a feature changes a shared cardinality run test plugins or any surface asserting the count before the local final gate not after ci
lessons.text: A registry-count change (15→17 specialists) shipped green under test:scripts but CI went red: the four plugin install-test rosters + shell installer advisories + config-cli help + README/FEATURES/marketplace copy are covered by test:plugins, which the local spec-driven final gate did not run. When a feature changes a shared cardinality, run test:plugins (or any surface asserting the count) before the local final gate, not after CI.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::retiring a compatibility boundary env var prefix config key feature flag needs a two direction test the new name reaches its target and the old name has zero effect a one direction test still passes if the old path is silently left wired up beside the new one
lessons.text: Retiring a compatibility boundary (env-var prefix, config key, feature flag) needs a two-direction test: the new name reaches its target AND the old name has zero effect; a one-direction test still passes if the old path is silently left wired up beside the new one.

lessons.key: gate_fail::two ci workflows test venues diverging silently isolates coverage a gated suite that skips in the blocking workflow s venue but runs in a non blocking one lets the required check report green while that suite never actually executed there assert venue parity between workflows not just presence in one
lessons.text: Two CI workflows' test venues diverging silently isolates coverage: a gated suite that skips in the blocking workflow's venue but runs in a non-blocking one lets the required check report green while that suite never actually executed there; assert venue parity between workflows, not just presence in one.
